newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Three stabbed in Venezuela jail fight.
newsitem.headline: Three stabbed in Venezuela jail fight.

text.p: Three prisoners were killed and six injured when rival gangs clashed in the El Rodeo jail in central Venezuela, prison officials said on Sunday.
The three received fatal knife wounds on Saturday when one group of inmates attacked the leaders of a gang that controls much of the prison about 20 miles (30 km) east of Caracas, officials said.
Venezuela's crowded and crumbling prisons are frequent scenes of violence, often involving improvised weapons filed down from cell bars and cutlery.
Last year, 206 inmates were killed and 1,633 injured in fights between prisoners and clashes with guards, according to the Justice Ministry.
